dek: The Government announced today (August 14) that the Financial Secretary, in exercise of the power delegated to him by the Chief Executive under the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Ordinance (Cap. 588), has appointed Ms Eva Lau Kin-yu as an Executive Director of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council
